summary: Iteration 124: Stripe Service Refactor + Send Payment Link Feature Tests. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: 'Send Pay Link' button present and working, endpoint reachable. Modal UI verified via code review since Stripe test-mode restrictions prevent full interactive flow testing.

minor.issue: Trailing slash causes redirect that drops Authorization header → 401. The correct path is GET /api/webstores/v2 (no trailing slash). This is a FastAPI redirect behavior, not a regression bug, but worth documenting for clients that append trailing slashes.

integration_issues.flow: Send Payment Link - Modal Interactive Test
integration_issues.issue: Modal cannot be tested interactively in this test environment. Stripe test account returns 400 ('destination account needs to have transfers capability enabled'). The frontend code correctly closes the modal and shows the Stripe error as a toast. This is expected test-mode behavior per task spec.

critical_code_review_comments: stripe_connect.py line 613: `if 'customer' in dir()` is unusual Python for checking local variable existence. Cleaner idiom would be `local_customer = None` and then conditionally assign it. Works but non-idiomatic.

Invoices.js generatePaymentLink: On Stripe error, `setPayLinkModalOpen(false)` closes the modal immediately. UX consideration: users may want a retry button inside the modal rather than being forced to re-click 'Send Pay Link'. This is a design decision, not a bug.
stripe_connect.py: send_invoice_payment_link correctly auto-detects customer_email from db.customers if body.customer_email is null — email pre-fill logic is correct.
stripe_service.py: Service refactor is clean — all business logic (fees, caching, helpers) is properly extracted from route handlers. No circular imports.
All modal elements have data-testid attributes (pay-link-amount, pay-link-url-input, pay-link-copy-btn, pay-link-open-btn, pay-link-email-input, pay-link-send-btn) — testability is good.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (Send Pay Link button verified, endpoint reachable, modal UI verified via code review; interactive modal flow untestable in Stripe test mode)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe test account does not have 'transfers' capability enabled, so POST /api/stripe-connect/invoice/{id}/send-payment-link always returns 400 in this environment. The modal opens briefly (setPayLinkModalOpen(true) fires before API call) but immediately closes on 400 error. All backend API tests pass. The modal JSX is correctly structured with all required elements and data-testid attributes. To test modal interactively, a Stripe account with transfers enabled would be needed.
